[[General/Legends|General]] '''Reesen Jivrak''' was a former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] officer removed from duty stemming from his unethical tactics. He and his followers eventually settled on [[Ohratuu]] with the intention of developing a beast army.
